community_list_entries.name: When Users Don't Ask: Benchmarking Context-Driven Memory Retrieval in Conversational Agents

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Conversational memory benchmark derived from LoCoMo with four query styles (dialog, implicit, counterfactual, composed), 6,581 items in total. Evaluates retrieval recall and end-to-end response quality across five memory systems. Preferences and updates are not targeted.
